_about: 1-Propanol (1) + Ethyl acetate (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 600.0 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-propanol, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: P. Susial  Badajoz, D. Garcia-Vera, R. Susial, V. D. Castillo, E. J. Estupinan, J. C. Apolinario, J. J. Rodriguez-Henriquez, Experimental Determination of Vapor Liquid Equilibria. Binary Systems of Methyl Acetate, Ethyl Acetate, and Propyl Acetate with 1-Propanol at 0.6 MPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 58 (2013) 2861-2867
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 13, 14. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.57 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
